objects.name: Splunk security advisory (AV26-614)
objects.description: Serial number: AV26-614 Date: June 17, 2026 On June 17, 2026, Splunk published security advisories to address vulnerabilities in the following product. Included was a critical update for the following: Splunk AI Toolkit – versions prior to 5.7.4 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply the necessary updates. OS Command Injection in the btool Configuration Helper in Splunk AI Toolkit Splunk Security Advisories
